name: tool_search
description: Finds the best available MCP tools for a task with ranked natural-language matching, safety/capability filters, connector filters, and optional input summaries. Understands related terms such as semantic → vector/relevance and database → SQLite/schema/query. Use when: choosing the right tool before acting, finding local-only or read-only tools, or checking required inputs. Scope: reads the local tool registry only; no network access. Not for: executing a tool, configuring credentials, or managing MCP client configuration.

query.description: Natural-language task or keywords. Matches names, descriptions, capabilities, and related terms. Optional.

tags.description: Comma-separated filters: api_required, local_only, network_access, write_tool, read_only, requires_confirmation.

module.description: Top-level module: code, data, memory, or tools.

submodule.description: Optional submodule filter, such as codebase_analysis or security.

connector.description: Only return tools requiring this connector, for example github.

include_inputs.description: Include required input names and all supported input names per result.
